title: Concert Attire Package Amount for Ensemble Members: Business Office Computation, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
**Concert attire package.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the uniform package of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** posts as the concert attire package. The concert attire package is the Fine Arts Performing Ensemble uniform package of the activity fee catalogue, rounded to the cent, and an attire package that works out to 0.00 posts nothing.

**Order of assembly.** Amounts are added together first, never below 0.00; any further amounts are then added to that total; and the result is rounded once, at the end, to the nearest cent with half a cent rounding up.

**Worked through (hypothetical figures).**

| Stage | Figures | Running figure |
|---|---|---|
| amounts added together | 36.00 and minus 11.00 | 25.00 |
| never below 0.00 | | 25.00 |
| further amounts added to that total | plus 7.00 and plus 3.50 | 35.50 |
| rounded once | | 35.50 |

If the amounts added together come to less than 0.00 (say a hypothetical minus 4.00), that total is taken as 0.00 and the further amounts are added to 0.00. A package that works out to 0.00 is not posted.
